q: What services does Luxe Atelier offer?
a: Luxe Atelier offers a comprehensive range of interior design services, including residential and commercial design, space planning, furniture selection, color consultation, and project management. Whether you're renovating your home or designing a new office space, we're here to bring your vision to life.

q: How much does Luxe Atelier's interior design services cost?
a: The cost of our interior design services varies depending on the scope of the project, the size of the space, and the specific requirements of the client. We offer customized solutions tailored to fit your budget and design preferences. Contact us to schedule a consultation and receive a personalized quote for your project.

q: What is the design process at Luxe Atelier?
a: Our design process typically begins with an initial consultation, where we discuss your goals, preferences, and budget for the project. From there, we develop a customized design plan that outlines the scope of work, timeline, and estimated costs. Throughout the design process, we collaborate closely with our clients to ensure their vision is realized, from concept development to final installation.

q: Can Luxe Atelier work with existing furniture and decor?
a: Absolutely! We understand that many clients may already have furniture and decor they wish to incorporate into their new design. Our team is experienced in blending existing pieces with new elements to create cohesive and harmonious spaces that reflect your style and personality. Whether you're looking to refresh your current decor or start from scratch, we're here to help.

q: How long does it take to complete an interior design project with Luxe Atelier?
a: The timeline for completing an interior design project varies depending on the size and complexity of the project, as well as factors such as client feedback and approvals. We work diligently to ensure that each project is completed in a timely manner without sacrificing quality. During the initial consultation, we'll provide you with a projected timeline based on your specific project requirements.
